WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26_q3, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25_q3,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region;

SELECT s.store_id, o.status, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
  AND (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code = 'WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2026-02-05' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_null_store', count(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2026-02-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT f.store_key) stores, count(*) AS rows_in_dups, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS keys, max(d.c) maxc, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_all_rows, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)

SELECT ty.region, ty.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ly.fiscal_year AS comparison_fiscal_year,

FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ty.region = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ty.region
